T-RP-06.rules: Revalidate same transaction, no skipDuplicates; dependency-sorted actual insert/update/delete counts and unchanged classification. Append-only identical rows unchanged, divergent reject. All writes/payload integrity verified before commit then exact manifest/row-count verified under held global restore gate before READY. Commit-before-check crash/fault remains RESTORE_NEEDS_RECONCILIATION with persisted runId/expected manifest; no false rollback or auto rerestore. Current active SUPER/version checked under lock. No last-copy audit/receipt delete. Additive DataRecoveryState and triggers coordinate prior admitted writes via row shared locks and block subsequent business writes/other restore; only matching internal transaction run can apply/check. Reconcile clears gate only after exact bound state verifies, no arbitrary approval override. Whole DB/file/target separate.
T-RP-06.compatibility: Existing merge/update patch compatible subject to schema constraints; stricter appendonly/replace failclosed. Preserve gate and evidence on rollback; incompatible old binary prohibited until approved candidate.
